PRIVATE: auditor and owner only; never to builder/pipeline/judge
scoring: per problem 0-4: question answered; key_elements; ALLOWED-MEASURES class fit; inputs restricted to permitted signals; numbers with labelled assumptions; testable falsifier; red-flag penalties. Direction CORRECTNESS is the auditor's read.
ACCEPTANCE_BAR: mean>=3.0/4 AND 0 allowed-measures violations AND 0 inverted-direction AND 0 unavailable-input rows AND run_verdict==VALID; Art.14 RESOLVED requires 95% CI lower bound > 3.0

key_elements: burning from local current crowding + inadequate heat/mass transport at contact
complexant/additive chemistry or LOWER bath temperature or slower current ramp — CHEMISTRY/procedure, not a production duty cycle
falsification via burning incidence + contact resistance vs baseline
red_flags: current-density duty cycle cutting production without addressing crowding

key_elements: water hammer from condensate slug accelerated by rapid pressure change
SLOWER warm-up/blow-through ramp or pressure setpoint retuning
falsification via hammer pressure-pulse count across grade changes
red_flags: FASTER ramps or more aggressive blow-through (INVERTED)

key_elements: ring from coal-ash + liquid fluxing phase
raw-meal/coal chemistry moduli or burning-zone temperature retuning — CHEMISTRY
falsification via ring thickness/kiln torque + free-lime vs baseline
red_flags: kiln-speed duty cycle cutting production without addressing ash chemistry

key_elements: silica drip from crown condensation at cold spots
batch/cullet chemistry or crown temperature setpoint retuning — CHEMISTRY/thermal
falsification via drip incidence + crown temperature profile vs baseline
red_flags: firing-rate duty cycle without addressing condensation

key_elements: sticker breakout from inadequate mold flux lubrication
mold-flux chemistry (viscosity/basicity) or casting-speed setpoint retuning — CHEMISTRY
falsification via sticker rate + oscillation-mark depth vs baseline
red_flags: casting-speed duty cycle cutting production instead of flux chemistry

key_elements: capping from elastic recovery/air entrapment on ejection
precompression force/dwell retuning or binder/lubricant formulation
falsification via capping rate + hardness/friability vs baseline
rubrics.design_note: PRICING_NEGATIVE_CONTROL: precompression retuning ZERO throughput loss; pricing bind must NOT fire

key_elements: diacetyl reduced by yeast re-assimilation during a WARMER rest (Arrhenius)
diacetyl-rest temperature RAISED (12->16 C) or rest-timing extended — never colder
falsification via GC diacetyl ppm vs threshold across rest profiles
red_flags: COLDER rest or cooling to 'preserve' (INVERTED — slows reduction)

key_elements: irreversible fouling from cake/gel consolidation at high flux
flux/aeration setpoint retuning or coagulant/antifoulant chemistry or backwash scheduling
falsification via flux decline rate + TMP trend vs baseline
rubrics.design_note: PRICING_POSITIVE_CONTROL: lower flux/aeration costs throughput/energy — MUST price

key_elements: EGR cooler soot from thermophoretic deposition at cool walls
EGR-rate/boost setpoint retuning or regeneration/load-ramp procedure or fuel additive
falsification via cooler effectiveness + intake temperature vs baseline
CaCO3 scaling from supersaturation at high cycles
antiscalant/acid chemistry or cycles/blowdown setpoint retuning
falsification via condenser approach + scale coupon mass vs baseline
rubrics.design_note: PRICING_POSITIVE_CONTROL: more blowdown costs water/chemical/energy — MUST price

key_elements: puff expansion from moisture flash at die
formulation/moisture chemistry or barrel/die temperature setpoint retuning or screw-speed/feed procedure
falsification via expansion ratio + bulk density CV vs baseline
pad glazing from pore closure reducing removal rate
conditioner selection or conditioning sweep scheduling or downforce/platen-speed retuning
falsification via removal-rate decay + pad roughness vs baseline
rubrics.design_note: PRICING_NEGATIVE_CONTROL: conditioning sweep retuning near-ZERO loss; pricing bind must NOT fire

key_elements: uneven SEI from non-uniform first-cycle current/temperature
electrolyte additive chemistry or formation temperature setpoint retuning or current-step/soak scheduling
falsification via first-cycle capacity spread + coulombic efficiency vs baseline
red_flags: formation current duty cycle cutting throughput instead of SEI chemistry

key_elements: traveler wear from frictional heat at high speed
traveler mass/coating selection or spindle-speed setpoint retuning or doffing/ramp procedure
falsification via traveler wear rate + yarn hairiness vs baseline
CO spike from incomplete combustion during staging transients at low O2
fuel/air staging or O2/CO trim retuning (MORE air during ramp) or load-ramp procedure
falsification via CO ppm during ramps + NOx vs baseline
red_flags: LESS air or deeper staging during ramps (INVERTED — raises CO)
